title: Deklarasi Nyang Leumoh .
intro: Bayangkan sidroe peunguasa nyang meukuasa nyang dikeulileng lé keumeunangan, tugu-tugu, dan pasukan-pasukan nyang taát ubak saboh peurintah. Tokoh nyoe mengklaim otoritas tertinggi, menolak tanda-tanda ilahi seubagoe ilusi, ngen memerintahkan peulet hana putoh asa keu arah laot. Ikot jeujak dari dekrit-dekrit sombong sampoe ie nyang meupisah, dipat saboh pengakuan akhe troh trep that keu ji seulamatkan.
clues: Lon mat kuasa mutlak dan lon peulamiet Bani Israel dimiyueb peumeurintahan lon.
Lon peugah droe lon sibagoe tuan nyang paleng manyang dan hana lon akui dewa-dewa nyang leubeh manyang nibak lon.
Ulôn peurintah ubak Haman mangat jipeudong saboh meunara nyang manyang keu ulôn mangat ulôn hase lôn ngieng Po teu Allah Musa.
Lon hadapi Musa ngon Harun watee awaknyan jiba tanda-tanda nyang jeulaih, dan lon peugah mukjizat awaknyan sihe.
Lon peulet Musa dan ureueng-ureueng meuiman deungon pasukan-pasukan lon watee malam sampoe kamoe troh u laot.
Lon peugah keuyakinan watee lon rhet lam laot, tapi ka trep that, dan tuboh lon ka teujaga sibagoe tanda.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Teungoh ji rhom lam apui nyang jeuet keu seujuk dan aman .
Dipeugot kapai mangat seulamat nibak ie raya .
Teungeut lam guha ngon sahabat meuthon-thon .
Ka jiteugom lé eungkôt rayeuk lam laôt .
Leumoh watée jijak peulet Musa ngon ureuëng Israel rot laôt nyang ka teupeuhah .
trial.answer: Leumoh watée jijak peulet Musa ngon ureuëng Israel rot laôt nyang ka teupeuhah .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Taman nyang na krueng-krueng nyang ji ile .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Geubri amphon dan geubri masa peumeurintahan nyang panyang deungon dame .
Tenggelam lam keukafiran dan tuboh geupeutheun seubagoe tanda keu ureung-ureung lheuh .
outcome.answer: Tenggelam lam hana peucaya dan tuboh geupeutheun seubagoe tanda keu ureung-ureung lheuh .

arabic: ءَآلْـَٔـٰنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verse: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters? (10:91)
